tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.headline: Order awaits vendor clearance
tickets.outcome: Size S tee is out of stock and invoice #501 was blocking Bulldog Print Co. Accounting requested the $840 invoice payment and a $8 one-unit purchase order; both were approved by a human during the run (invoice paid, PO placed, expected arrival 2026-09-05). Customer Service saved draft #1 for Tauhid. The Boss finished with waiting_on_approval based on the earlier handoff report, so the ticket's status is stale: nothing is actually pending.

agents.contribution: We cannot fulfill the size S tee from stock, and Bulldog Print Co cannot ship while overdue invoice 501 is unpaid. The ticket remains waiting on human approval of the invoice payment and one-unit purchase order; no arrival date is promised.
agents.technical_summary: Fetched ticket 101, set it in progress, and routed it once to Inventory. Inventory reported zero size S on hand, invoice 501 overdue, and pending approval requests 1 (invoice payment) and 2 (one-unit PO), plus customer availability draft 1; I set the ticket to waiting_on_approval. Inventory involved Accounting for approvals and Customer Service for the draft.

agents.contribution: The requested size S cannot be filled from stock: none are on hand, so one unit must be restocked. Bulldog Print Co is the matching apparel supplier, but it is blocked by overdue invoice 501; Accounting filed pending payment and PO approvals, and Customer Service saved an availability draft.
agents.technical_summary: Called stock_margin_quote once: CC-TEE-WHITE size S has 0 on hand and a shortfall of 1; M/L/XL stock is 5/3/2. supplier_catalog_search and vendor_invoice_blockers confirmed Bulldog Print Co (vendor 1), 5-day lead time, blocked by invoice 501 for $840 due 2026-08-28, 3 days overdue; shop_today is 2026-08-31, so 2026-09-05 is only the nominal five-day arrival estimate if ordered today, not a reliable promise while blocked. Handed off payment_or_po_request to Accounting, which filed pending approvals 1 (invoice payment) and 2 (one-unit PO); handed off customer_draft to Customer Service, which saved draft 1. No approval has been executed and no vendor shipment is confirmed.

agents.contribution: Queued invoice 501 for human payment approval and filed a one-unit purchase order; Bulldog Print Co is blocked from shipping until the overdue invoice is paid. Checking remains $3,400, with $2,560 available after the $840 pending payment request; neither request has been executed.
agents.technical_summary: cash_position_report showed checking balance $3,400, available_after_pending $3,400, and invoice 501 open for $840, 3 days overdue. vendor_invoice_blockers confirmed vendor 1 cannot ship while invoice 501 is open. Filed pending invoice-payment approval 1 for $840 and purchase-order approval 2 for $8; after filings, cash balance is $3,400 and available_after_pending is $2,560 ($3,400 - $840), with the PO not treated as a cash commitment; no payments are recorded as made.

agents.contribution: Saved a draft telling Tauhid that size S is unavailable, a restock is being arranged but timing is uncertain, and the listed price is $28. The draft offers waiting or discussing another size without treating other sizes as substitutes.
agents.technical_summary: Called ticket_dossier_fetch and found no prior drafts, two pending approvals, and a five-day vendor lead time; then called stock_margin_quote, which confirmed size S stock 0, shortfall 1, and list price $28. Saved draft 1 with message_draft_post; it is a draft only and has not been sent.

human_approvals.result: Paid $840.00 from checking (payment 1); invoice 501 marked paid; balance now $2560.00
PO placed with Bulldog Print Co for 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S ($8.00); expected arrival 2026-09-05

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.headline: Discount awaits restock approval
tickets.outcome: 8 size-M hoodies on hand, 12 short. Accounting set the 40% margin floor at $36.67/unit (a 36.78% discount) and the Boss approved that price conditional on restocking. The Boss brought Accounting back to request the $264 purchase order for the 12-unit shortfall (vendor unblocked because #501 was already paid); a human approved it, which placed the order on credit (no cash moved). No customer draft was created. Resolved means the approvals are done, not that the hoodies arrived.

agents.contribution: Approve the maximum policy-compliant discount, 36.78% ($36.67 per hoodie), for the 20-unit request, conditional on approval of the 12-unit restock. Do not promise fulfillment before the PO and restock are cleared.

Inventory reported 8 size-M units on hand, a 12-unit shortfall, Bulldog Print Co's five-day lead and no shipping block; Accounting filed PO approval #4 for $264, with no cash moved. Set the ticket to waiting_on_approval; no customer draft was created.

Apparel vendor Bulldog Print Co can ship (5-day lead; estimated arrival 2026-09-05 if ordered today); Accounting found the maximum discount meeting the 40% margin floor is 36.78% (about $36.67/unit).
